## README.md
# TWIG Interagency Fuel Treatments, United States

Fuel treatments and related land management activities across the United States, compiled by the
Southwest Ecological Restoration Institutes (SWERI) from five federal and state reporting systems.
1,491,072 treatment polygons covering the 50 states, Puerto Rico and Guam.

This is the **interagency** record: US Forest Service activity data alongside Department of the
Interior, state forester and interagency fuel-treatment records.

- **Source:** [TWIG Data Resources](https://reshapewildfire.org/resources/twig-data-resources/), ReSHAPE
- **Licence:** [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- **Citation:** Call, A., et al. (2025). A new geodatabase of fuel treatments across federal lands in
  the USA. *Scientific Data* **12**, 1485. <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-05859-z>
- **Accessed:** 2026-09-17 (publisher last edited the service 2026-09-02)

## Assets

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-fire/twig-treatment-index-2026-08.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-fire/twig-treatment-index-2026-08.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-fire/twig-treatment-index-2026-08/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

## Read it with DuckDB

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

SELECT twig_category, COUNT(*) AS treatments, ROUND(SUM(acres)) AS reported_acres
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-fire/twig-treatment-index-2026-08.parquet')
WHERE status = 'Completed'
  AND treatment_date BETWEEN DATE '1980-01-01' AND DATE '2026-09-17'
GROUP BY twig_category
ORDER BY reported_acres DESC;
```

## Show it on a map

The MapLibre `source-layer` is **`twig-treatment-index-2026-08`** (the last segment of the dataset
name, not the source layer name).

```js
map.addSource('twig', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-fire/twig-treatment-index-2026-08.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'twig-fill',
  type: 'fill',
  source: 'twig',
  'source-layer': 'twig-treatment-index-2026-08',
  filter: ['==', ['get', 'status'], 'Completed'],
  paint: {
    'fill-color': [
      'match', ['get', 'twig_category'],
      'Mechanical', '#8c6d3f',
      'Planned Ignition', '#c4622d',
      'Unplanned Ignition', '#a03030',
      'Chemical', '#4a7fa5',
      'Biological', '#5a8f5a',
      '#888888'
    ],
    'fill-opacity': 0.6
  }
});
```

## Four things to get right

### 1. Summing `acres` does not give treated ground

The same stand is thinned, piled, pile-burned, then re-entered years later. Each is its own polygon
with its own acres, so the acreage column counts that ground several times. Repeat treatment is real
and worth measuring, but it is not additional area.

```sql
-- reported activity: how many acres of treatment were recorded
SELECT SUM(acres) FROM read_parquet('.../twig-treatment-index-2026-08.parquet')
WHERE status = 'Completed';

-- treated ground: distinct H3 cells, which collapses the overlap
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h8) FROM read_parquet('.../twig-treatment-index-2026-08/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet');
```

Report both and say which is which.

### 2. Planned work is included

| status | treatments | acres |
|---|---:|---:|
| Completed | 1,249,074 | 121,205,444 |
| Planned | 240,404 | 50,596,043 |
| Other | 1,321 | 688,625 |
| Started | 273 | 352,605 |

An unfiltered total overstates accomplished work by roughly 42%. Every tabulation must state its
status filter.

### 3. Dates need a sanity window

`treatment_date` runs from **1202-02-10 to 2926-10-03**.

| window | records |
|---|---:|
| 1980-01-01 to 2026-09-17 | 1,429,746 |
| after 2026-09-17 | 61,314 |
| before 1980 | 12 |

Nothing has been removed. Apply an explicit window and report how many records you discarded.

### 4. On the hex, join on `h8`

Resolution varies with polygon size. 1,490,993 treatments are indexed at resolution 10, the 71
largest at 9, and the 7 largest at 8; `native_res` records which. A single 21,000 km² polygon would
generate roughly 1.4 billion cells at resolution 10, so the largest are held coarser deliberately.

`h8` is populated on every row. `h10` is empty for the 78 treatments held at 9 or 8, so joining on
the finest column silently drops them.

```sql
-- correct
SELECT * FROM twig t JOIN other o ON t.h8 = o.h8;
-- wrong: the 78 largest treatments vanish
SELECT * FROM twig t JOIN other o ON t.h10 = o.h10;
```

Per-treatment totals (`acres`, `total_cost`, `cost_per_uom`, `SHAPE__Area`, `SHAPE__Length`) are
repeated on every cell a treatment covers. Reduce to one row per treatment before adding them up:

```sql
SELECT SUM(acres) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unique_id, acres FROM twig WHERE status = 'Completed');
```

## Relationship to `facts-common-attributes-2026-06`

737,013 of these records come from the same Forest Service source as the
`facts-common-attributes-2026-06` collection, but carry a reduced attribute set (no `SUID`,
`FACTS_ID`, method/equipment codes, fund codes or per-unit costs) while adding four other source
systems. **Keep both, but do not union them** — the Forest Service treatments would be counted twice.

| source system | records |
|---|---:|
| FACTS Common Attributes | 737,013 |
| FACTS Hazardous Fuels | 608,983 |
| NFPORS | 64,365 |
| NASF | 52,136 |
| IFPRS | 28,575 |

## Known data quirks

- **`error` is multi-valued**, semicolon-separated, so test with a containment match rather than
  equality: `WHERE error LIKE '%DUPLICATE_DROP%'`. 85,997 records carry at least one flag. Parsed
  counts: `DUPLICATE_DROP` 34,634, `DUPLICATE_KEEP` 30,473, `BUFFERED_LINE` 15,561,
  `MODIFIED_SHAPE` 2,694, `BUFFERED_POINT` 2,108, `SPATIAL` 815, `HIGH_COST` 550, `CHECK_UOM` 65,
  `LARGE_AREA` 4. `DUPLICATE_KEEP` records are the ones the publisher chose to retain; do not drop
  them.
- **`BUFFERED_LINE` and `BUFFERED_POINT` geometries were synthesized** from a line or a point, so
  their acres are not a measured footprint. 17,669 records.
- **One record has no geometry.** It is present in the GeoParquet and absent from the hex and tiles.
- **One record is mislocated.** A 1.9-acre Virginia treatment is mapped into the Atlantic off South
  America, flagged `SPATIAL` by the publisher. It is what stretches the bounding box east to 51°W.
- **Guam is included** (2 NPS treatments near 144.8°E), so a naive bounding box spans most of the
  globe. The collection publishes separate sub-bounding-boxes for the two clusters.
- **`SHAPE__Area` and `SHAPE__Length` are in square degrees and degrees**, not square metres and
  metres, because the source service computed them in longitude and latitude. Use `acres` for area.
- **Stray whitespace was trimmed** during conversion: 70,516 records in `activity` and 96,713 in
  `equipment` carried trailing spaces that would otherwise break equality filters. Ten records in
  the free-text `name` column retain theirs.
- **`uom` is not always acres.** 33 records are in miles and 32 are per-each; they cannot enter an
  acreage-based cost total. 145,076 carry no unit, which the publisher treats as acres.
